launches.title: Wingman Law: AI-native personal injury law firm where attorneys direct AI agents
launches.tagline: Wingman Law: AI-native personal injury law firm
launches.body:
# **TL;DR**

Wingman Law is an AI-native personal injury law firm. Instead of handing your case to a pyramid of case managers, **our attorneys lead a team of AI agents** that keep it moving. We only get paid when our clients win.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=125445&key=user_uploads/1045396/2a542a65-24be-444d-8bc6-7ae9834321e1)

### **The Problem**

Personal injury is bottlenecked by humans. Every case depends on case managers chasing clients, providers, and insurers, so firms can only grow by hiring more of them. For clients, that means long stretches without updates and slow progress toward a payout.

### **Our solution**

Wingman Law is an AI-native personal injury law firm: attorneys direct AI agents instead of case managers. Cases move faster and clients gets more attorney attention.\
\
We built our own operating platform for the firm, where attorneys can direct AI agents in plain English. Our platform coordinates AI agents to gather the evidence, work across cases in parallel, and prepare the documents and communications needed for the next step. Because calls, texts, emails, and case files are connected, the agents can carry that work from the underlying evidence through to an action ready for attorney approval.

### **Why we built this**

**Sunwoo** has a JD from Harvard Law as well as an MS and BA from Stanford. She worked in world class litigation teams at Orrick and Fish & Richardson, where the smallest cases were worth $50M, but found herself wanting to help injured individuals where the impact felt more tangible.

During law school, she built and sold $350K worth of legal tech. So much of her energy went into integrating with legacy systems. Now she puts that energy into building agents that help clients win. 

**Nick** is a licensed attorney who has worked on more than 700 Bay Area personal injury cases, both at a plaintiff’s firm and on the insurance defense side (Habbas Law and Kern, Segal & Murray).

He was also employee #2 at Strongsuit building litigation platform for law firms. That experience made him realize how much faster and better he could build as a technical lawyer if he were building for his own firm. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=125445&key=user_uploads/1045396/77c8aa6f-3f33-4c25-931d-bc290d7ba0e2)

### **Our Ask**

Attorney solicitation rules limit how we can approach potential clients (which is why we got this Tesla wrapped!), so word-of-mouth introductions are especially valuable.

If you, a friend, a family member, or a coworker is looking for legal help after an injury in California, we’d love to help. We work on contingency so there is no out of pocket cost to our clients. We handle cases involving car accidents, bike and scooter crashes, and premises liability like slip and fall. Please shoot me an email at [sunwoo@wingmanlaw.com](mailto:sunwoo@wingmanlaw.com).
